steps.sql: SELECT "payroll_documents"."employee"."position"."department"."name" AS "department", "COUNT"() AS "documents", "SUM"("amount") AS "total" FROM "payroll_documents" WHERE ("status" <> $1) GROUP BY "payroll_documents"."employee"."position"."department"."name" HAVING ("SUM"("amount") > $2) ORDER BY "SUM"("amount") DESC

SELECT "COUNT"(DISTINCT "employee"), "SUM"("amount") FILTER (WHERE ("status" = $1)), "ARRAY_AGG"("amount" ORDER BY "period" ASC), "STRING_AGG"(DISTINCT "status", $2 ORDER BY "status" ASC) FROM "payroll_documents"
SELECT "status", "period", "SUM"("amount") FROM "payroll_documents" GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (("status", "period"), ("status"), ("period"), ())
CREATE TABLE "fio_copy" ("id" UUID PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "all_types" ("integer_value" INTEGER, "float_value" FLOAT, "decimal_value" DECIMAL(38,10), "text_value" TEXT, "boolean_value" BOOLEAN, "timestamp_value" TIMESTAMP, "date_value" DATE, "json_value" JSON, "uuid_value" UUID, "bytes_value" BYTES, "embedding" VECTOR(768))
CREATE TABLE "constraint_collision" ("a_b" INTEGER, "c" INTEGER, "a" INTEGER, "b_c" INTEGER, UNIQUE ("a_b", "c"), UNIQUE ("a", "b_c"))
ALTER TABLE "people" ADD COLUMN "revision" INTEGER DEFAULT $1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "uq_people_live_email" ON "people" ("email") WHERE ("deleted_at" IS NULL)
INSERT INTO "people" ("id", "email", "fio") VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET "email" = "excluded"."email", "fio" = "excluded"."fio" RETURNING *

INSERT INTO "payroll_documents" ("id", "employee", "period", "amount", "status") VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT ("employee", "period") DO UPDATE SET "amount" = "excluded"."amount", "status" = "excluded"."status" RETURNING *
UPDATE "payroll_documents" SET "amount" = ("amount" * $1), "status" = $2 WHERE (("period" BETWEEN $3 AND $4) AND ("status" IN ($5, $6)))
DELETE FROM "people" WHERE (("deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("deleted_at" < $1)) RETURNING "id"
SELECT "p"."id", "p"."email", "f"."name" FROM "people" AS "p" INNER JOIN "fio" AS "f" ON ("p"."fio" = "f"."id")
SELECT "p"."id", "f"."name" FROM "people" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "fio" AS "f" ON (("p"."fio" = "f"."id") AND ("f"."name" IS NOT NULL))

SELECT "d"."id", "p"."email", "pos"."name", "dep"."name" FROM "payroll_documents" AS "d" INNER JOIN "people" AS "p" ON ("d"."employee" = "p"."id") LEFT JOIN "positions" AS "pos" ON ("p"."position" = "pos"."id") LEFT JOIN "departments" AS "dep" ON ("pos"."department" = "dep"."id")
SELECT "p"."id", "f"."id" FROM "people" AS "p" RIGHT JOIN "fio" AS "f" ON ("p"."id" = "f"."id")
SELECT "p"."id", "f"."id" FROM "people" AS "p" FULL JOIN "fio" AS "f" ON ("p"."id" = "f"."id")
SELECT "p"."id", "f"."id" FROM "people" AS "p" CROSS JOIN "fio" AS "f"
SELECT * FROM "people" WHERE (("people"."position"."department"."active" = $1) OR ("position" IS NULL))
SELECT "p"."id", "f"."name" FROM "people" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "fio" AS "f" ON ("p"."fio" = "f"."id")
WITH "paid" ("employee", "amount") AS (SELECT "employee", "amount" FROM "payroll_documents" WHERE ("status" = $1)) SELECT "employee", "SUM"("amount") FROM "paid" GROUP BY "employee"
SELECT * FROM "people" WHERE EXISTS (SELECT $1 FROM "payroll_documents" WHERE (("payroll_documents"."employee" = "people"."id") AND ("payroll_documents"."amount" > $2)))
SELECT "id" FROM "people" WHERE ("deleted_at" IS NULL) UNION SELECT "employee" FROM "payroll_documents"
SELECT "id" FROM "people" WHERE ("deleted_at" IS NULL) INTERSECT SELECT "employee" FROM "payroll_documents"
SELECT "id" FROM "people" WHERE ("deleted_at" IS NULL) EXCEPT SELECT "employee" FROM "payroll_documents"

SELECT "id", "email" FROM "people" WHERE ((((("active" = $1) AND (("hired_at" >= $2) OR ("hired_at" IS NULL))) AND (("email" LIKE $3) OR ("email" REGEXP $4))) AND ("deleted_at" IS NULL)) AND NOT (("position" IN ($5, $6)))) ORDER BY "email" ASC, "id" ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT "id", CASE WHEN ("amount" >= $1) THEN $2 WHEN ("amount" >= $3) THEN $4 ELSE $5 END AS "bucket", CAST(("amount" * $6) AS TEXT) AS "gross_text" FROM "payroll_documents"

SELECT "id", "employee", "amount", "ROW_NUMBER"() OVER (PARTITION BY "employee" ORDER BY "amount" DESC NULLS LAST), "SUM"("amount") OVER (PARTITION BY "employee" ORDER BY "period" ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM "payroll_documents"
